info.desc: With Teeth (also known as Halo 19 or WITH_TEETH]) is the fifth full-length studio album by Nine Inch Nails, released on May 3, 2005. It spawned three singles (The Hand That Feeds, Only and Every Day Is Exactly The Same), four tour legs, and much celebration for Trent Reznor's sobriety. According to a statement on nin.com, Reznor stated that producer Rick Rubin was Reznor's "mentor" and "source of inspiration" throughout the planning and writing process of the album. Reznor was also heavily inspired by the use of more analog electronic effects and instruments, specifically tape delay and modular synthesizers, stating .

podcast.body: In 2005, while discussing the Nine Inch Nails album "With Teeth," Trent Reznor mentioned his past collaborations, including his unreleased work with Zack de la Rocha. This comment provided a rare, direct acknowledgment from Reznor about the project's existence and its fate. "But in 2005, when I was speaking to Trent about the Nine-inch Nails album with Teeth, he dropped in a comment about working with Zach in tapeworm."

podcast.body: This album marked a turning point for Trent Reznor, following his intensive rehab and recovery from addiction in 2001. It contains 13 songs, seven of which feature Dave Grohl on drums. "This lead us to the With Teeth album in 2005."

podcast.body: This album, released in 2005, marked Trent Reznor's return to music after six years dealing with addiction and a subsequent period of recovery and refocusing. It was the start of a new mission for the artist. "he was on a mission, which started with a 2005 album entitled With Teeth."

podcast.body: Trent Reznor admitted to having been in a pretty dark, horrible place, and needed the time to realize that he still loved music and still needed to make it, around the time of the "With Teeth" album's release in early 2005. podcast.body: This album marked Trent Reznor's return to Nine Inch Nails after a six-year hiatus, released in 2005. It followed a period where Reznor had cleaned up and overcome addictions. "He'd cleaned up, dumped his addictions, and had just released the 9-inch nails album with teeth. It was his first album in six years..."
